name: Hammer
overview: Scripture uses the hammer both literally and figuratively to illustrate God's power and craftsmanship. In Isaiah 41:7 and Jeremiah 10:4, the hammer is depicted as a tool used by craftsmen to shape and secure metal, symbolizing careful and purposeful work. Figuratively, Jeremiah 23:29 compares God's word to a hammer that breaks rock, emphasizing its powerful and penetrating effect. Additionally, Jeremiah 50:23 portrays the hammer as a symbol of strength and judgment, describing the downfall of Babylon as the breaking of the 'hammer of the whole earth.'
